summary: Iter48 covers the latest batch of features (bulk-delete, forgot-password + approve-all, face enroll/scan/confirm with lookalike + guru-face-to-teacher-attendance, teacher-attendance today/week/export/archive, schoolgram follow/save/takedown/restore + role gating, guests CRUD + lifecycle, izin keluar homeroom-only create + gate approval). Backend: 20 passed + 1 skipped (no missing guru after prior pass marked all 'hadir') via /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_phase_full.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter48.xml). Frontend: verified every required data-testid exists in the referenced JSX (accounts-kelas-filter, bulk-delete-button, new-account-nisn/nis, bulk-role-siswa, reset-approve-all, reset-approve-{id}, forgot-* fields, forgot-success-message, faceid-stage, face-role-guru, guest-new/guest-card-modal/guest-id-card, ik-form, teacher-att-today/teacher-manual-{id}-{status}, sg-* tabs, student-id-card id-card-nis + id-card-valid). Playwright-driven UI execution could NOT run this iteration: the browser_automation tool wrapper returned 'invalid syntax' for every script (even a single `print("hello")` -> line 4), indicating a harness/wrapper issue outside my control; please have main agent re-run UI tests when harness is healthy.
action_items: Re-run Playwright UI tests when the browser automation wrapper is restored (currently returns 'invalid syntax' on any script, even trivial ones).
Consider adding an explicit /api/health endpoint for easier liveness checks (current public /api/health returns 404).
Forgot-password endpoint: in-memory/mongo rate limit (3 per email per 15m) can cause test flakiness; a 'test mode' bypass or admin reset would help regression suites.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 6194 lines; please split by domain (accounts/face/schoolgram/guests/izin/teacher_att). Previous iter also flagged.

bulk_delete_users excludes current admin via {'id': {'$ne': user['id']}} + dscope - good; but if roles=['super_admin'] + no kelas, it will remove other super_admins silently. Consider requiring explicit kelas OR confirming 'HAPUS_SUPER_ADMIN' when role list contains super_admin.

face_enroll uses mean-vector consistency check (max distance from mean > 0.45) - sensible, but FACE_DUP_THRESHOLD=0.42 vs FACE_MATCH_THRESHOLD=0.5 means some real-world self-matches may be flagged lookalike; monitor false positives.

forgot-password requires 'min_length 8 + letter + digit' but field validation is Field(min_length=8) only server-side; current implementation performs regex check post-identity-match. Fine, but if identity check fails the password-rule 400 is never shown.
ik context endpoint returns 'students' only when guru is homeroom - correct. create_ik enforces homeroom-of-student but non-homeroom guru creating for a student in another class returns 403 (good).

schoolgram sg_delete_post and sg_edit_post rely on _assert_manage which allows only ketua_kelas/super_admin - takedown/restore endpoints additionally require SG_MODS (super_admin, ketua_osis). Role matrix matches spec.
GET /api/users/{id} appears not to exist (returned 405 during test). If this is intentional, remove any frontend/test code expecting single-user GET; otherwise add it.
Session-scoped fixture warning (pytest 10): consider classmethod-based schoolgram post_id fixture.
test_credentials: Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md used as-is; siswa password restored to BaruSiswa123 at test end via forgot + approve-all.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and destroy ephemeral TEST_ accounts (bulk delete), TEST_ guest, TEST_ schoolgram post, TEST_ IK request, and transient face profiles for siswa/osis/guru (deleted afterwards). password_reset_requests collection is cleared before TestForgotReset to avoid 429.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_phase_full.py. Clearing collection password_reset_requests before forgot tests is auto-handled via fixture. The siswa fixture logs in with BaruSiswa123 (per memory file). GET /api/users/{id} is not supported - use GET /api/users list and filter by id. All required data-testid attributes verified by grep in the referenced JSX components.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional defects detected in-scope. The one impediment was tooling: browser_automation wrapper raised SyntaxError at a line beyond the user script, consistent with a bug in the executor's templating (not user script content).
